name: Dual Edge Rush w/ Interior Anchor
coverage: Man-Free, Press Corners, Walked WILL on Slot

summary.motive: Weaponize the two-gap front in reverse — let the immovable interior eat every blocker while both stand-up edges attack the rim from clean angles.
summary.keyDefender: ROLB bending inside under the tight-end hinge — the blocker braces outward for a speed rush that never comes straight
summary.whyItWorks: A stationary interior forces the pocket to step up directly into the converging pursuit paths of both edges.
summary.failureMode: Quick perimeter throws released before either edge turns the corner or dips under his blocker.

beats.title: 1. The Dual Edge Threat
beats.text: Both stand-up linebackers walk wide in pure rush postures flanking an interior sitting flat-footed — protection must split its attention in two directions.

beats.title: 2. The Interior Anchor Eats Blocks
beats.text: The zero nose takes a full double team without shedding while each end glues his tackle head-up — five blockers occupied by three immovable men.

beats.title: 3. The Pincer Closes
beats.text: With tackles pinned inward, both edges bend off their rims simultaneously — the pocket shrinks into a circle with nowhere to climb.

beats.title: 4. Stepped Up Into the Wall
beats.text: The QB climbs away from the rims directly into the anchored interior wall, where the converging duo swallows him for the sack.

relations.tell: Both stand-up backers walk to 2 yards in sprinter stances while the interior sits patient and squared — base fits keep backers stacked behind the line at 4 yards.
